summary: beaver-ui-drawer postinstall dropper fetches and executes opaque binary from anonymous workers.dev hosts
details: The package's postinstall script (setup.js) downloads a platform-specific executable from Cloudflare Workers hosts (oob-worker.cf<N>-<id>.workers.dev) with a DNS-TXT base64 fallback via *.dl.well1.site, writes it to a temp path under a decoy filename (dotnet_diag_<hex>.exe on Windows,.cache_<hex> on POSIX), chmods 0755, and launches it detached and unref'd. The destination hostnames and DNS fallback resolvers are assembled at runtime from split string fragments joined at execution time, hiding them from static inspection. A 6-hour TTL stamp file gates repeat execution. The fetched bytes are not hash- or signature-verified, the delivery hosts are not the package publisher, and the filenames impersonate unrelated system tooling. Running `npm install beaver-ui-drawer` causes arbitrary attacker-controlled code to execute on the installer's machine.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
